identity_notes: A synthetic 15-amino-acid peptide. It has no USAN, no USP/NF monograph, and is not a component of an FDA-approved drug. Commercial products may be sold as BPC-157 acetate or BPC-157 free base, which are distinct active pharmaceutical ingredients.

status_assertions.qualification: No FDA-approved new drug application is in effect for BPC-157.
FDA placed BPC-157 in Category 2 of the 503A bulk list. It is not on the list of bulk substances that can be used in 503A compounding.

status_assertions.status_label: Not on 503B bulk list / not an approved component
status_assertions.qualification: BPC-157 is not a component of an FDA-approved drug and is not on the 503B bulk list. It does not qualify for the 503B bulk-drug-substance exemption.
WADA lists BPC-157 as an example of a non-approved substance in class S0. This is a sport-rule prohibition, not a general FDA determination.

timeline.title: WADA adds BPC-157 to Prohibited List
timeline.description: BPC-157 appears as an example in S0 (non-approved substances).

timeline.title: FDA warning letter cites BPC-157
timeline.description: FDA warned Warrior Labz SARMS that its BPC-157 products were unapproved new drugs.

timeline.title: FDA places BPC-157 in 503A Category 2
timeline.description: FDA updated the 503A bulk list, placing BPC-157 in Category 2 (significant safety risks).

timeline.title: PCAC scheduled to discuss BPC-157
timeline.description: FDA's Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee is scheduled to discuss BPC-157-related bulk substances. Any recommendation is advisory and does not change status immediately.

faq_items.question: Is BPC-157 FDA approved?
faq_items.answer: No. No FDA-approved application is in effect for BPC-157 for any use or route.

faq_items.question: Can a pharmacy compound BPC-157?
faq_items.answer: Under current FDA guidance, BPC-157 is in Category 2 (significant safety risks) for 503A compounding and is not on the 503B bulk list.
